capabilities: Gather daily-note tasks into to-do, overdue, upcoming, and project backlog sections
Schedule and reschedule tasks with start and due dates, including bulk sweeps
Move task lines into project notes and create projects from templates
Complete tasks through the Tasks plugin API with undo for every edit
Pace projects by work-in-progress limit, deadlines, or a hybrid mode
extras: Formerly named Taskflow; the README includes migration steps (new plugin id, settings copied on first start). Pre-release builds available via BRAT. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; works on desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: began as a fork of obsidian-checklist-plugin by delashum
problem: Obsidian's daily notes capture tasks as they come up, but there is no single view to triage, reschedule, file, and finish them across days and projects.

relations.evidence: Daily Task Panel reads tasks through Tasks and completes them through its API
began as a fork of obsidian-checklist-plugin by delashum
This plugin was called Taskflow until September 2026

summary: Sidebar panel that gathers tasks from daily notes into to-do, overdue, upcoming, and project backlog views with scheduling, triage, and completion actions.
